say:1:1611139001:0.text: Gervan, stop! You set all of this in motion, and now you don't have the stomach to see it through?
say:1:1611139001:0.source_cn: 格墨文，住手！你做出了这一切，却没有胆量面对最后的结果？！

say:4:1611139002:0.text: See it through... to my failure, again.
say:4:1611139002:0.source_cn: 结果……就是我再次失败了。

say:5:1611139003:0.text: Why? Why can't I ever win?
say:5:1611139003:0.source_cn: 为什么？为什么我永远赢不了？

say:6:1611139004:0.text: I've given everything I had, but someone always stands in my way. First Cassadee, and now you!
say:6:1611139004:0.source_cn: 我已经付出了所有努力，但始终有人挡在面前，先是科丝蒂，...
say:6:1611139004:0.male: I've given everything I had, but someone always stands in my way. First Cassadee, and now you!
say:6:1611139004:0.female: I've given everything I had, but someone always stands in my way. First Cassadee, and now you!

say:7:1611139005:0.text: Why should one accident make me lose everything? I've fought so hard to prove myself, yet I can never surpass the natural prodigy!
say:7:1611139005:0.source_cn: 为什么仅是一次意外，我就要失去一切？我拼命想证明自己，...

say:8:1611139006:0.text: Merlin, you're a living legend. People sing of your deeds, honor surrounds you... and you've never even had to pay a price.
say:8:1611139006:0.source_cn: 梅林，你是传奇的人物，你活在荣誉和赞颂下，你的故事被人...
say:8:1611139006:0.male: Merlin, you're a living legend. People sing of your deeds, honor surrounds you... and you've never even had to pay a price.
say:8:1611139006:0.female: Merlin, you're a living legend. People sing of your deeds, honor surrounds you... and you've never even had to pay a price.

say:9:1611139007:0.text: Why you? Why does someone like you get everything, while I get nothing?!
say:9:1611139007:0.source_cn: 为什么是你，为什么是你们，不是我？！
say:9:1611139007:0.male: Why you? Why does someone like you get everything, while I get nothing?!
say:9:1611139007:0.female: Why you? Why does someone like you get everything, while I get nothing?!

choice_prompt:11:1611139007.text: Why you? Why does someone like you get everything, while I get nothing?!
choice_prompt:11:1611139007.source_cn: 为什么是你，为什么是你们，不是我？！
choice_prompt:11:1611139007.male: Why you? Why does someone like you get everything, while I get nothing?!
choice_prompt:11:1611139007.female: Why you? Why does someone like you get everything, while I get nothing?!

say:16:1611139010:0.text: But you'll also have to sacrifice yourself for Esperia, just like Merlin did.
say:16:1611139010:0.source_cn: 但你要像梅林大人那样，为拯救伊索米亚而自我牺牲！
say:16:1611139010:0.male: But you'll also have to sacrifice yourself for Esperia, just like Merlin did.
say:16:1611139010:0.female: But you'll also have to sacrifice yourself for Esperia, just like Merlin did.

say:19:1611139012:0.text: We saw his memories... his doubts... and yet, even so, he made the right choice. Could you do the same?
say:19:1611139012:0.male: We saw his memories... his doubts... and yet, even so, he made the right choice. Could you do the same?
say:19:1611139012:0.female: We saw her memories... her doubts... and yet, even so, she made the right choice. Could you do the same?

say:22:1611139014:0.text: Magister Merlin is right, Gervan. You were born with every advantage, a name that opens doors. Even without a title, you had more resources than any of us could dream of.
say:22:1611139014:0.source_cn: 梅林大人说得没错，格墨文，你拥有我们都无法企及的家世，...
say:22:1611139014:0.male: Magister Merlin is right, Gervan. You were born with every advantage, a name that opens doors. Even without a title, you had more resources than any of us could dream of.
say:22:1611139014:0.female: Magister Merlin is right, Gervan. You were born with every advantage, a name that opens doors. Even without a title, you had more resources than any of us could dream of.

say:23:1611139015:0.text: Look at me. I'm just ordinary. Born into a fallen noble family. I scraped my way into the Serene Lyceum, but I'm nothing special. My luck isn't good or bad, it's just... average.
say:23:1611139015:0.source_cn: 你看，我才是那个什么都不出色的人。出身算是贵族，但早已...

say:24:1611139016:0.text: But I have my own goal. You all know that. I swore I would restore my family's honor.
say:24:1611139016:0.source_cn: 但我也有我自己的目标，你们都知道的，我发誓要恢复家族的荣光。

say:25:1611139017:0.text: Gervan, whether it's walking the path of magic or being your friend, everything I did was for that goal.
say:25:1611139017:0.source_cn: 格墨文，走魔法道路也好、和你成为朋友也好，的确都是我为...

say:26:1611139018:0.text: And even if I lost everything, I wouldn't give up. I'd find another way, keep moving forward. That's my path.
say:26:1611139018:0.source_cn: 可哪怕失去了这一切，我也不会放弃，我会找到其他的路，继...

say:28:1611139020:0.text: So, what now? You're going to interrogate me here, or throw me in a cell?
say:28:1611139020:0.source_cn: 你们打算就地审问我，或者是送我去监狱？

say:29:1611139021:0.text: No. That's not our call. We're turning you over to Envoy Evie; she'll handle it from there.
say:29:1611139021:0.source_cn: 不，我们无权做这些事，我们会将你交给伊芙特使，剩下的事...

say:31:1611139023:0.text: I'll be waiting in my cell. Let's see which one of you ends up the true winner...
say:31:1611139023:0.source_cn: 我会在监狱里等着，看看你们谁才是最后的胜利者……

narration:32:1611139024:0.text: You use a binding spell to restrain Gervan, ensuring he can't escape.
narration:32:1611139024:0.source_cn: 你用法术禁锢了格墨文，保证他无法从魔法塔中逃脱
narration:32:1611139024:0.male: You use a binding spell to restrain Gervan, ensuring he can't escape.
narration:32:1611139024:0.female: You use a binding spell to restrain Gervan, ensuring he can't escape.

narration:33:1611139025:0.text: He'll be handed over to Evie once the selection exam officially concludes.
narration:33:1611139025:0.source_cn: 他将被移交给伊芙——在选拔赛彻底结束之后

choice:13:0:1.text: You become Merlin. Take all the glory, but—
choice:13:0:1.source_cn: 你成为梅林，享受所有荣耀，但……
choice:13:0:1.male: You become Merlin. Take all the glory, but—
choice:13:0:1.female: You become Merlin. Take all the glory, but—

choice:11:0:1.text: Then how about we trade places?
choice:11:0:1.male: Then how about we trade places?
choice:11:0:1.female: Then how about we trade places?
